questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how PATCH requests are applied to a campaign? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A client calls GET /v1/campaigns?limit=500. What happens?
choices: 200 with up to 100 campaigns; the limit is silently capped
422 Unprocessable Entity; FastAPI rejects the value before the handler runs

choices: 200 OK and the created campaign without a Location header
201 Created, a Location header /v1/campaigns/<id>, and the created campaign in the body
201 Created with an empty body, since the client can fetch it from Location
302 Found redirecting to the new campaign
